Dr Danielle Gibson
Service:
Specialist in Veterinary Oncology
Education:
BVSc (Hons) CertAVP(SAM) AFHEA DipECVIM-CA (Oncology)
Dr Danielle graduated from the University of Sydney in 2010. She worked in small and mixed animal general practice in Australia for 2 years before moving to England in 2013.
In the UK, she undertook a small animal rotating internship at the University of Cambridge and a small animal oncology residency at the University of Liverpool. Dr Danielle passed her certifying exams to become a veterinary oncology specialist in 2024. Danielle enjoys all aspects of small animal oncology.
Outside of work, Danielle enjoys reading, traveling and scuba diving.
